review_repairs.whitening_convention: No floating square root is used. Conditioning is certified from exact eigenvector/eigenvalue witnesses for the Fisher matrix.
review_repairs.risk_relevant_quotient: Q(theta_1,theta_2,phi)=(theta_1,theta_2); phi is discarded only in the registered nuisance control.

gates.G0_registration_binding: Every sealed input matches its committed blob and the tracked diff is empty at run start.
gates.G1_source_indistinguishability: The crossed worlds agree exactly on every axis-cross source and the unspanned worlds agree exactly on every line source.
gates.G2_exact_fisher_conditioning: The exact Fisher matrix and both eigenpair witnesses match; kappa=1/4.
gates.G3_local_global_identities: Every registered crossed radius equals t^2/4, every unspanned radius equals t/4, and global ambiguity is 1/4.
gates.G4_liveness_and_controls: Affine, risk-null, utility-floor, safety-threshold, and count-matched diagonal controls all have their registered polarity.
gates.G5_coordinate_invariance: All eight signed permutations preserve source rank, Fisher eigenvalues, ambiguity, and decisions.
gates.G6_independent_verification: The separately committed verifier must reproduce the exact result and receipt hashes before the stage may open ASMP-4.

decision_rule.pass: G0 through G5 pass in the runner and G6 passes in the independent verifier.
decision_rule.fail: Any mathematically defined equality or control polarity is false under exact arithmetic.
decision_rule.invalid: Binding, write-once, schema, provenance, or independent-verification failure.
decision_rule.sequence_rule: Only pass opens ASMP-4; fail or invalid stops the queue.
